notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42640372/e22046da3b42ef4cd3297b761afb02c6b1ed8c3c.png

Thank you for playing Pretty Girls Breakout! PLUS!
Pretty Girls Breakout! PLUS update Ver. 1.0.1 is now available!

Version 1.0.1 Update
Fixed a bug where the item icon would remain on the screen when the effect of the protection expired.
Fixed a bug where the character and stamp operation buttons were not displayed when performing certain operations in the dressing room diorama.
Made minor adjustments and changes.
